newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asian Banking Corp closes $60 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Asian Banking Corp closes $60 mln FRCD.

text.p: Asian Banking Corp's US$60 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been completed, said arranger LTCB Asia on Friday.
The five-year certificates were priced at par to float at 55 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. There are put and call options in year three.
With fees, the all-in reutrn for top tier managers is 70 basis points.
Arrangers are Bayerische Vereinsbank, Commercial Bank of Korea, Industrial Bank of Korea, KEB International, LTCB Asia and WestLB Asia Pacific.
Gulf International Bank is co-lead manager.
